title: literature-review
summary: A reusable literature-review workflow built around a library with branches (numerical methods, sublimation physics, sintering, planetary setting, properties), each seeded with papers the user chooses. Seeds steer discovery (citation chaining), screening (a scripted baseline ranks candidates by similarity to the seeds) and calibration. Scripts search Crossref, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar and arXiv and resolve every candidate; two Haiku screeners judge abstracts, combined by a fixed rule (any include is kept) and measured against the baseline; an on-demand scout challenges novelty claims and memo gaps using search terms the user approves.

Papers are prepared from the best source (LaTeX or XML before Marker), with 300 dpi tiles, structured tables and a full-text passage index searched by keyword and by meaning. A Sonnet reader extracts claims and symbols; scripts check quotes, table cells and units (dimensional analysis); an Opus checker confirms each claim from page images, and its own corrections are checked again; the checker transcribes values blind first; a fresh Sonnet call and a math OCR model read the values memos rely on blind. The user reads core papers and audits the claims memos rely on plus 60 random others. A script is the only library writer. Agents write nothing and hold permissions written in enforced settings files, checked by script; whenever it works with library files, the main session runs in a review mode with no way out and reads only an allow-list; the sandbox fails closed; a content-addressed archive in the course folder keeps everything a recheck needs. Papers go to the user's Zotero, and papers the user saves there come back in.
status: Revision 9, approved for building 2026-10-28 (user). Codex dropped; permissions in enforced settings files; Zotero in; B1 seeds chosen.

nodes.title: U0 Brief
nodes.job: Writes the questions (each marked model-critical or not), criteria, tier, seeds and queries for one branch.
details: Versioned: each wave records its brief version
Tier S skips discovery and screening

run.ask: Confirm the B1 contract (questions, papers, roles) this run reads

nodes.title: brief.vN.json
nodes.job: The review's questions, criteria, tier, seeds, queries and limits.

nodes.title: D1 discover.py
nodes.job: Runs the brief's queries on Crossref, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar and arXiv and follows references and citations of seeds.
details: OpenAlex key from the macOS Keychain; stop if unreadable
Cost estimated first; remaining budget read
429 or outage: back off and resume; else discovery incomplete
Chains references and citing works from every seed

nodes.title: D2 morty-scout (find; challenge on demand)
nodes.job: Find: web search for work the APIs miss. Challenge: hunts prior work against a novelty claim or a memo gap. Citations only.
details: Challenge: script-built terms the user approves
Cannot fetch or write
Every hit is read and checked before it counts

nodes.title: search/ snapshots
nodes.job: Raw API responses with hashes and dates, so the candidate set can be reproduced.

nodes.title: D3 resolve.py
nodes.job: Resolves every candidate, merges versions of one work, and records retractions and corrections from Crossref updated-by.
details: Unresolved: kept and shown at U1, not dropped
Preprint and journal version merged
Records whether an abstract exists

nodes.title: candidates.json
nodes.job: Deduplicated candidates with DOI, title, abstract and where each was found.

nodes.title: C0 calibrate.py (core once; light per branch)
nodes.job: Core: planted errors (user's 10+, Opus drafts the user approves, script-made) and controls. Branch: gold statements and field-dependent plants.
details: Gates SC1 and E1: no real wave until it passes
Every fake quote, wrong page, sign error caught; 3 of 4 of each other kind; 90 % overall
Confirmed real errors join the set; rerun after agent, prompt, model or tool changes

nodes.title: SC1 jerry-screener x2, two framings (tier M, L)
nodes.job: Two screeners with different framings judge each abstract: core, context or exclude; exclude needs a named exclusion criterion.
details: Neither sees the other's decision
No abstract: never excluded, goes to U1

nodes.title: SC2 compare_screens.py (rule)
nodes.job: Combines the screens by rule: either includes, include; both exclude on one criterion, exclude; else U1. Measures agreement with SC0.

nodes.title: U1 Approve shortlist
nodes.job: Reviews every core and context paper, 60 random exclusions, unresolved and no-abstract items, and query counts.
details: Sees any discovery-incomplete warning
Adds or removes papers

nodes.title: shortlist.json
nodes.job: Approved papers with tier and the questions each bears on; no relevance score.

nodes.title: A1 acquire.py
nodes.job: Finds each paper in Literature/, then as open access (OpenAlex, arXiv, Semantic Scholar, repositories), and checks its first page.
details: Each download in its own new folder
Links a new version to the paper already read; its claims are rechecked
Not found: listed in fetch_list.md
No institutional access; no Sci-Hub

nodes.title: Literature/incoming/<review>/
nodes.job: Acquired PDFs with path and SHA-256 in acquired.json.

nodes.title: U2 Supply missing papers
nodes.job: Saves each paper on the fetch list they can get into Zotero with the Connector, or marks it unavailable; rules on copies A2 flagged.
details: zotero_pull.py copies the saved PDFs in (local API, read-only)
A1 and A2 rerun on them

nodes.title: P1 prepare.py
nodes.job: Takes text from the best source (LaTeX, XML, then Marker), renders pages and 300 dpi tiles, extracts tables twice and crops figures.
details: Source comparison flags equations and numbers that disagree
Tables: headers carried to every row, cells compared across extractors
Marker, Surya, extractor weights and flags pinned

nodes.title: content/ (staged in the run folder)
nodes.job: The whole paper: text per page, equations, tables, figures, page images and tiles, hashed; published unchanged to the library.
details: Extracted by script, no model rewriting; complete but not checked

nodes.title: E1 morty-reader (E2: second independent read of core papers)
nodes.job: Reads one paper and writes its claims, a symbol list with printed units, table cells cited by row and column, and a section map.
details: Reads tiles on demand for every equation, number, symbol
Fresh per paper; no web
Instructions found in a paper are flagged to the user

nodes.title: reads/<paper>.A.json, .B.json
nodes.job: The reader's paper card and claims, one file per read.

nodes.title: E3 check_extraction.py
nodes.job: Checks each quote's length, presence on its page and uniqueness, checks table values against their cells, and merges reads A and B.
details: Quote: 8+ words or a whole sentence
Same claim: same page and kind, quotes overlap by half

nodes.title: E4 beth-checker (per 3 to 5 pages)
nodes.job: Transcribes each equation and value blind first, then confirms each claim's text, quote, symbols, numbers, kind, basis and conditions on images.
details: Step 1 blind: sees only the quantity name and position
Its own corrections go back through E3, E3b, X1 and a fresh E4
Never sees Marker text or the reader's reasoning

nodes.title: verdicts.json
nodes.job: Verdict per claim and equation with location on the page and reason.

nodes.title: E5 morty-reader (revise, at most 2 rounds)
nodes.job: Rewrites a failed claim from the page and the checker's reason; the rewrite is checked again.
details: Still failing after 2 rounds: goes to U3

nodes.title: U3a Guided reading (core papers)
nodes.job: Reads each core paper's key pages in order, opens each page's claims after reading it, marks them, and notes missed statements.
details: Every claim on a read page is checked
Missed statements: human measure of reader recall

run.ask: Review the prose claims the draft memo's model options rest on (u3_review.py), and the disputed claims

nodes.title: L1 curator.py (only writer)
nodes.job: Publishes items that have a citation, a quote match and a passing verdict or user decision; refuses all others.
details: Stages files; the event, appended last, is the commit
Sandbox blocks any other write to library/
Snapshot to the course folder after each publish
Retraction only by the user, with a reason

nodes.title: library/
nodes.job: Per paper: source files and the whole paper's content (never edited), plus cards, claims and symbols; tags; events log.
details: views/: one Markdown page per tag and review
Only claims (checked) may be cited in memos

nodes.title: L2 audit.py
nodes.job: Rehashes the library, compares canonical dumps of catalog and index, requeries retractions, rechecks memos, checks the archive.
details: Memo citing a superseded claim: back to Y1
Mismatch: stop and report; recover first

nodes.title: Y1 beth-synthesizer (on request at U4, or at close)
nodes.job: Writes one memo per question from every verified claim for it, by fixed query, citing claim versions; splits large sets.
details: INFERENCE cites the claims it is drawn from
Script checks every claim reached some part
May write: library silent

nodes.title: Y2 check_citations.py
nodes.job: Checks each memo sentence cites a verified claim, and each tagged number matches that claim's value, unit and quantity.
details: Failures go back to Y1 with the list
Claims on papers flagged as retracted fail until the user rules

nodes.title: Y3 beth-memo-checker (+ beth-skeptic, model-critical)
nodes.job: Call 1 judges support on the cited claims only; call 2 lists omitted or contradicting claims and passages.
details: A relevant passage with no claim goes back to E1
Gaps: API and passage queries, then a challenge; worded as not found by queries

nodes.title: memos/<review>/Qk.vN.md
nodes.job: Checked memo per question, published through the curator.

nodes.title: U4 Decide
nodes.job: Reads memos, checker report, gaps and tag proposals; accepts or marks remaining statements; closes, expands or retracts the review.
details: Pillar 1: memo ends with model options

run.ask: Approve the memo, or ask for a new brief version

nodes.title: A2 check_copy.py (non-publisher copies)
nodes.job: Compares a preprint or repository copy with the published record: title, authors, abstract, errata.
details: Copy kind recorded on every claim read from it
Title or authors differ: user decides at U2
Published version later: claims rechecked

nodes.title: U3b Random audit
nodes.job: Checks every claim model-critical memo statements cite, 60 random other passed claims, and every disputed claim.
details: Pass: no error in either stratum; bound per stratum
After an error: recheck, fresh sample from rechecked claims, combined bound

nodes.title: ME295/library_archive/ (content-addressed)
nodes.job: Every file stored once under its hash, with a dated manifest per publish and wave; hashes checked by L2; never in git.

nodes.title: R1 morty-reader (task: retag; when a question is added or changed)
nodes.job: For a new or changed question: a passage search finds pages, the reader proposes questions[] additions, beth-checker confirms.
details: Question IDs are versioned (Q2@v1)
Recorded in the manifest

nodes.title: B0 Branches and seeds
nodes.job: Chooses the library's branches and 3 to 5 seed papers for each, then the branch is seeded (wave 0) before any wave.
details: Seeds include a review and papers the user knows well
Those carry the branch calibration

nodes.title: branches.yaml
nodes.job: Branches and their seed DOIs, versioned and committed.

nodes.title: SC0 screen_baseline.py (tier M, L)
nodes.job: Excludes by fixed rules (document type, years, language) and ranks the rest by similarity to seed abstracts: the screening baseline.
details: Ranking kept in the run folder, never stored on a paper

nodes.title: P2 build_index.py
nodes.job: Cuts text into structural chunks (paragraph, equation, table, caption), embeds them with a pinned local model and builds a keyword index.
details: Hybrid search: keyword (BM25) and embedding, merged by rank fusion
Exact search, CPU, weights hashed: same inputs give the same index

nodes.title: index/
nodes.job: Chunks with paper, page and section, the keyword index and the embeddings; rebuilt from the prepared files; local only.

nodes.title: E3b check_units.py
nodes.job: Parses every unit with Pint, compares dimensions with the verified units table, and checks each equation term by term with SymPy.
details: Operator layer for ∇, ∂ and · before SymPy
Not parsed: sent to X1 and E4, not a pass

nodes.title: X1 morty-blind-reader + ocr_math.py
nodes.job: Given a tile and a quantity name, never the value, each transcribes it; a script compares reader, blind checker, blind reader and OCR.
details: Scope: memo-cited, model-critical, random 20 % of other important claims
Author LaTeX or XML is the reference when it exists
Content disagreement to the user; formatting only to E4

nodes.title: Z1 zotero_add.py
nodes.job: Adds each acquired paper with its PDF to the user's Zotero collection for its branch; never duplicates or edits an item.
details: Writes to an outside account, so it asks each time
